cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As building manager, I'll establish why this door won't lock. Describe the anomaly. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hinge is loose. I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Precisely. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?

mechanism: A acts as an investigative building manager, uses B hinge diagnosis and tool requirement to invent the next stage, and swaps practical roles to retain B help.
confusable: Unlike competent leadership that simply delegates repair, A performs method while learning basic next steps and even tool location from B; cooperation supplies the competence.
comparison: A physical door repair and manager desk differ from a missing-object inquiry in the wrong location.
seedUse: D138-b loose hinge, usual repair and screwdriver drawer; S02-b trades holding and fetching roles around B needs.
